paragraphs: (“Of Elon, the family of the Elonites,” Numbers 26:26.) He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 44:5, speaking in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The matching Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text is Shemot Rabbah 44:8 and writes Rabbi Aloni ben Tavri. Hyman supplies 44:5 and bar Tavri; both locator and name-form differences remain explicit.

The whole Masoretic Numbers 26:26 verse has the Elonite family phrase. The whole Torat Emet Shemot Rabbah 44:8 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Aloni ben Tavri reporting Rabbi Yitzchak, supporting the local titles. Hyman’s 44:5 locator and bar Tavri form remain unchanged; this does not identify the person with the biblical family or harmonize him with the separate Elino pointer.
